identifier: Two things the operator (kyuhwan) stated on 2026-09-23 in answer to one question from this seat: that the room thermometer reads in steps of one degree, and that the air conditioning holds the room to roughly plus or minus one degree.
grade_rule: E5. Stated from knowledge of the room, not read off an instrument at the moment of asking, so it takes the recollection grade rather than the reading grade (5.3). The answer did not say the thermometer was looked at when it was given, and the second half carries its own hedge -- 'roughly' -- which is what a recollection sounds like and not what a reading sounds like. Which of the two a statement is belongs to the person; the conservative grade is filed until the person says otherwise, and a reading taken at the thermometer would supersede the first entry at E3.
